g.title: PWN_Reinforcement_Learning
g.text: live accounting · optional curriculum / weights · explicit routing-policy evaluation

g.title: Run
g.text: Loop: plan, Dispatch, guard, final answer
semantic_ok: grep exit 1 need not be failure

g.title: Credit
g.text: PRM: step rewards; sentinel: proxy distrust

g.title: Later
g.text: RSI records ESR / ASR; ESR drop → lesson

g.title: Schedule
g.text: Create a CURRICULUM_JOBS template only when wanted
Templates stay disabled until explicitly enabled
Seeding does not install system crontab

g.title: Practice
g.text: Practice: budget-first; real tools may run
Offline judge: backfill, calibrate, warm sentinel

g.title: Schedule->Practice
g.text: independent jobs; not a job chain

g.title: Train
g.text: Dry run or no trainer → export_ready only
ollama create → candidate vs baseline gate

g.title: Model
g.text: On passing gates: update curriculum model state
Optional local weight path, not routing policy
Export alone is not training or improvement

g.title: Hygiene
g.text: Includes memory consolidation; not model training

g.title: Select
g.text: No automatic handoff from RSI or training

g.title: Eval
g.text: Regression replay is a separate split

g.title: Gate
g.text: Not proof of general live LLM gains

g.title: Approve
g.text: Replace routing policy, not model weights

g.title: Receipt
g.text: No silent overwrite of newer policy state
